scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/client && npm run build -w packages/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/container-metadata-types && npm run typecheck -w packages/container-metadata-server && npm run typecheck -w packages/client && npm run typecheck -w packages/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/server && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.js tests/*.test.ts
